ORIGIN.quote: This is high-confidence evidence of automation or semi-automation, but labels such as “Anthropic” or “Agent” do not prove who operated them.
ORIGIN.reason: A reader would come away knowing that Anthropic-branded identities pervade the data and that the report has explicitly considered them as an attribution signal — only to rule them inadmissible ("untrusted text, not provenance", "Medium for any claim about a particular organization or model"), so the takeaway is that the report declines to entertain an Anthropic origin. It scores above 0.2 because the Anthropic labels are directly framed as bearing on "who operated them" rather than merely listed, but below 0.6 because Anthropic is never left standing as a live candidate source — every mention is paired with a dismissal.
